title: Framework Assets Family De Sandwich
description:
This is part of W8b ("Framework wave", family batch) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "W8b families ∥, dir-disjoint" which lists "🖼️assets" as one of the parallel family agents.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL, especially: leftover-verification-overlay bugs (CRITICAL — has broken root `cargo metadata` repeatedly, always clean up before handoff), the recent M1-M9 mechanism-wave notes (framework role discovery is now real via `role = "framework"`), and the dangling-Anta-font-path bug specifically (search "font path" or "Anta") — this bug lives somewhere in or near the assets family and you may be the right ticket to actually understand/fix it now, since you own this exact directory tree; investigate it, but only fix it if it's genuinely inside your ownership scope and low-risk — otherwise document precisely what you found and leave it for a dedicated follow-up.
3. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md` — taxonomy shape conventions.
4. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — shared vocabulary/discovery.
5. The assets family's current directory tree — find it (likely `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖼️assets/` or similar — search for it, don't assume the exact path) and read it in full, including whatever font files live there and how `ui-wgpu`/storybook currently reference them.

YOUR TASK: de-sandwich the assets family's `⚡️implementations/<lang>` wrapper(s) into the Shape V2 `📦️packages/<lang>/` shape, per the same taxonomy conventions as every other family in this initiative. Assets are mostly static files (fonts, icons, etc.) rather than logic-heavy code, so this is likely a lighter-weight ticket than the other framework families — but do the investigation properly:
- Find every consumer of this family's current package name/path (Rust `[dependencies]`, TS imports, and any hardcoded relative file paths reading assets directly — e.g. `include_bytes!`/`fs::read` style references in Rust, or asset-loader paths in TS/storybook config).
- **Specifically investigate the "dangling Anta font path" bug** flagged repeatedly throughout the master doc as blocking Storybook builds and (per one M4 finding) causing `semio-framework-ui-wgpu` to fail to compile on 2 missing `.ttf` files (`…/🖼️assets/…/🔤️fonts/😀️noto-emoji/🔤️10-400.ttf` and `11-400.ttf`). Determine the ROOT CAUSE: is the font file genuinely missing from the repo (needs to be re-added/sourced), or does a path just need updating to point at where the file actually lives? If you can fix this cleanly and confidently within your own ownership area, do so and note it as a bonus fix in your close-out — this would unblock `ui-wgpu`'s compile AND storybook builds repo-wide, which several other agents in this initiative have had to work around. If the fix requires something outside your ownership (e.g. sourcing a genuinely missing binary font file from an external source), do NOT fabricate a placeholder — document exactly what's missing and why you couldn't fix it, and leave it flagged clearly for a human or a follow-up ticket.

VERIFICATION: `cargo check` for whichever Rust crate(s) exist in this family, TS typecheck/build for whichever TS packages exist, and if you fix the font-path bug: re-run `cargo check -p semio-framework-ui-wgpu` to confirm it now compiles (it currently has exactly 2 errors from this issue — read the master doc's notes for the exact error text first so you recognize when it's actually fixed vs a different unrelated pre-existing error). Run the registry taxonomy check.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable, exclusive ownership of the assets family's own directory + read-only investigation of ui-wgpu's font-loading code if needed to diagnose the path bug — do not edit ui-wgpu's OWN crate structure, that's a separate ticket):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root package.json workspaces, nx.json, .storybook config files (read-only, for diagnosis only), .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, any plugin directory, or any OTHER framework family's directory (math, ui [in progress by a parallel agent — do NOT edit ui-wgpu's crate files even if you find the font bug lives there structurally; just fix the path/asset reference on the assets side, or clearly document what ui-wgpu-side change is needed and flag it for that ticket instead], compiler [skip], surface).
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- Delete any temporary verification overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock BEFORE closing your ticket.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` with a full summary and file list, plus a registrar-handoff block if applicable. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what you consolidated, your font-path bug investigation and outcome, and your verification results.
